## Vacancy finding — 620 Madison St, Oakland (APN 001-0173-013-00)

**Verdict:** unknown (confidence 0.25). Public listings describe a one-unit historic residence, but the accessible evidence does not establish present occupancy. Zillow says off market, which only means not listed on Zillow. County fee rolls report one unit in FY 2023-24 and FY 2025-26; they are not vacancy records. The visible third-party permit history ends in 2013. No reliable, dated vacancy indicator was located.

**Vacancy start:** unknown. **Duration:** unknown; no supported start date or continuous-vacancy period can be determined from these sources.

Sources: [Zillow property page](https://www.zillow.com/homedetails/620-Madison-St-Oakland-CA-94607/24737433_zpid/), [Realtor.com property page](https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhomes-detail/620-Madison-St_Oakland_CA_94607_M24876-77891), [City of Oakland planning EIR](https://www.oaklandca.gov/files/assets/city/v/1/planning-amp-building/documents/dp/ceqa/2011-present/lake-merritt-station-draft-environmental-impact-report-volume-ii.pdf), [FY 2025-26 county levy roll](https://www.stopwaste.org/sites/default/files/ACWMA%20-%20Preliminary%20Levy%20Roll%20FY%202025-26.pdf), [FY 2023-24 county fee report](https://www.stopwaste.org/sites/default/files/Alameda%20County%20Waste%20Management%20Authority%20-%20Prelim%20Data%20Report%20FY%202023-24.pdf).
